title: The Memory Wanderer
description: A woman in a long coat and scarf stands in a ruined, tiled room with peeling walls and broken picture frames, holding a vintage suitcase. She looks out into a vast surreal desert landscape at night where a horse-drawn carriage is illuminated by a beam of light from an old film projector mounted on a pedestal.
prompt: A lone woman in a vintage trench coat and scarf stands inside a decaying ornate room with cracked tile floors and crumbling walls filled with broken golden picture frames. She holds a worn leather suitcase and gazes out into a vast surreal desert under a starry twilight sky. A horse-drawn carriage gallops across the dunes, illuminated by a powerful beam of light from a vintage film projector placed on a marble pedestal. Scattered film reels, old photographs and an armchair lie among the ruins, cinematic lighting, highly detailed surreal painting
